points.statement: The work aims to handle diverse degradations within a unified restoration framework for practical applications.
points.quote: All-in-one image restoration, which aims to address diverse degradations within a unified framework, is critical for practical applications.

points.statement: The framework uses dynamic self-attention to adaptively attend to long-range spatial dependencies.
points.quote: employs a dynamic self-attention mechanism that adaptively attends to long-range spatial dependencies

points.statement: A convolution component captures long-range degradation similarities while preserving awareness of global structural information.
points.quote: captures long-range degradation similarities while maintaining awareness of global structural information

points.statement: Model capacity to adapt to different degradations is increased through channel and spatial interactions.
points.quote: efficiently increasing the model capacity to adapt to different degradations through channel–spatial interactions

points.statement: The attention mechanism combines patch-level and pixel-level gradient-orientation descriptors, emphasizing spatial regions according to perceived degradation.
points.quote: integrates patch-level and pixel-level HOG descriptors, adaptively emphasizing spatial regions based on perceptual degradation

points.statement: It prioritizes important gradient orientations and magnitudes to enable more robust feature representations for unified restoration.
points.quote: prioritizes critical gradient orientations and magnitudes, enabling more robust feature representation for all-in-one restoration

points.statement: Gradient magnitude and orientation jointly encode local intensity and directional structure, giving discriminative cues.
points.quote: gradient magnitude and orientation, which jointly encode local intensity and directional structure

points.statement: A feed-forward component promotes global information exchange using shuffle and gated mechanisms over spatial and channel dimensions.
points.quote: promotes global information exchange through shuffle and gated mechanisms across spatial and channel dimensions

points.statement: A loss supervises gradient orientation and magnitude to maintain edge and structural integrity.
points.quote: supervises gradient orientation and magnitude to preserve edge and structural integrity

points.statement: The unified model restores various degraded images.
points.quote: restore various degraded images in a unified model
